### 1️⃣ Auto-Generated Passwords (Backend + Frontend)

**Backend** - `server/controllers/adminController.js`:
```javascript
// ✅ Create Student (Line 103-107)

// Sets isFirstLogin: true

// ✅ Create Faculty (Line 293-297)

// Sets isFirstLogin: true
```

**Security Features**:

### 6️⃣ Department Dropdown Implementation

**Files**: `Students.jsx` + `Faculty.jsx`

**Implementation**:
```jsx
// ✅ Added useQuery to fetch departments
const { data: departmentsData } = useQuery({
  queryKey: ['departments-list'],
  queryFn: async () => {
    const response = await apiClient.get('/admin/departments');
    return response.data?.data || [];
  },
});

// ✅ Converted text input to SELECT
<select
  value={formData.department}
  onChange={e => setFormData({ ...formData, department: e.target.value })}
  required
>
  <option value="">Select Department</option>
  {(departmentsData || []).map(dept => (
    <option key={dept._id} value={dept.departmentCode}>
      {dept.departmentName} ({dept.departmentCode})
    </option>
  ))}
</select>
```
